text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober has injured herself<n>during training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ow! How can it hurt this much?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why was I so stupid? I<n>shouldn't have
pushed myself so<n>hard...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the worst part is, I won't be able<n>to run for a
while...
choice_data_list: Let's just focus on healing up.
We'll make up for it once you're better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I know. Not like I could do<n>much even if I
wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, enough talk. I'll rest up, so<n>you can go
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you. I'm going to<n>get some rest,
so you can get back to<n>work now.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looks miserable as she<n>fights
against her pain and frustration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Believe me, I'm planning to<n>make up for
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll get better little by little and return<n>to training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I barely even moved... Just<n>how long is this
going to take to heal?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looks beyond<n>devastated when she
realizes how<n>severe and persistent her pain is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I need to stay optimistic. This could<n>be a good
learning experience!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since I can't move at all, can<n>you give lectures
instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That way, when I'm all recovered, I'll<n>be better
equipped to make up for lost<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober makes the most out of<n>her
convalescence, and afterwards<n>seems to have
discovered something<n>new!
